# Vendored rdkafka-sys with librdkafka 2.16.0

Status: adopted 2026-10-12. Remove this fork and its `[patch.crates-io]` entry once a published
`rdkafka-sys` bundles librdkafka 2.16.0 or later.

## Why

The newest published `rdkafka-sys` (4.10.0+2.12.1, used by rdkafka 0.39.0) bundles librdkafka
2.12.1. librdkafka 2.13.0 through 2.16.0 fix, among others: re-bootstrap that never reached a
bootstrap broker and a transaction coordinator that was not reset with its broker (2.16.0),
`rd_kafka_query_watermark_offsets()`/`rd_kafka_offsets_for_times()` touching a destroyed client
(2.16.0), KIP-848 consumer-group error handling (2.15.0), a timer data race and a `LeaveGroup`
crash on close (2.14.2), and member-id uniqueness on Windows (2.13.0). None adds KIP-939
prepared-transaction participation.

## Provenance

| Part | Source |
|---|---|
| Crate (`build.rs`, `src/lib.rs`, `README.md`, `update-bindings.sh`, `bindings.h`) | crates.io `rdkafka-sys` 4.10.0+2.12.1, checksum `e234cf318915c1059d4921ef7f75616b5219b10b46e9f3a511a15eb4b56a3f77` |
| `librdkafka/` | `https://github.com/confluentinc/librdkafka/archive/refs/tags/v2.16.0.tar.gz`, sha256 `e6b61de61d3282879a88e4ee3d9f634a8b05bf78a9198dfc25c4820c0c9ed231`, tag commit `c6c9973cf1b25394c58e0cade13a36f386856f77` |

Only what the CMake and `configure` builds read is kept from the tarball: `src/`, `src-cpp/`,
`packaging/cmake/`, `win32/`, `mklove/`, `CMakeLists.txt`, `Makefile`, `configure`,
`configure.self`, `lds-gen.py`, the license files, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` and
`CONFIGURATION.md`. Tests, examples, and the other packaging targets are omitted; the build
script disables tests and examples.

## Local changes

- `src/bindings.rs` is regenerated by the crate's own `update-bindings.sh` with bindgen-cli
  0.72.1 and libclang from `rust:1.95-bookworm`. The same procedure reproduces the published
  2.12.1 bindings byte for byte. Against 2.12.1 the 2.16.0 bindings add declarations and new
  response codes 103, 114-116, 119-128 and 130-133 (`RD_KAFKA_RESP_ERR_END_ALL` moves from 130
  to 134); no existing declaration changes. Because every C enum is a Rust enum, linking 2.16.0
  under the old bindings would make those codes undefined behavior, so the regeneration is
  required, not cosmetic.
- `src/types.rs` and `src/helpers.rs` map the new response codes in `RDKafkaErrorCode`, which is
  `#[non_exhaustive]`.
- `Cargo.toml` version is `4.10.0+2.16.0`.

## Scope

Workspace builds (embedded library tests, the server binary, release artifacts) use this fork.
Cargo does not apply workspace patches to consumers of the published crates; they resolve
`rdkafka-sys` 4.10.0+2.12.1 unless they add the same patch.
